sentences.en: When I first started reporting this story over a year ago, there was a lot of noise around how and what our public schools were teaching on issues of race.
sentences.zh: 一年多前我刚开始报道这个故事时，关于我们的公立学校在种族问题上如何教学、教什么，外界有很多喧嚣。

sentences.en: On one side, the right was leveling relentless accusations that schools were indoctrinating children with radical views, with critical race theory.
sentences.zh: 一方面，右翼不断指责学校用激进观点和批判性种族理论给孩子们洗脑。

sentences.en: And on the other side, the left, and we should acknowledge the mainstream media, was responding with blanket embattled denials.
sentences.zh: 而另一方面，左翼——我们也应该承认，主流媒体——则以全面且激烈的否认作为回应。

sentences.en: We were seeing clips of raucous school board meetings.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了喧闹的校董会会议片段。

sentences.en: The attorney general empowered the FBI to help monitor threats against school employees and board members.
sentences.zh: 司法部长授权联邦调查局协助监控针对学校员工和董事会成员的威胁。

sentences.en: And last year, the governor's race in Virginia was partly decided around how topics of race were being addressed in Virginia schools.
sentences.zh: 去年，弗吉尼亚州的州长竞选在一定程度上就是由弗吉尼亚州学校如何处理种族话题决定的。

sentences.en: Yet for me, what was missing amid all the din was any discussion, any knowledge of what was actually happening inside K-12 classrooMs.
sentences.zh: 然而对我来说，在所有这些喧嚣中缺失的是任何讨论，以及对K-12课堂内实际情况的了解。

sentences.en: And for this magazine story that you'll soon hear, the classroom was where I wanted to be.
sentences.zh: 对于你即将听到的这篇杂志报道，课堂就是我想去的地方。

sentences.en: My name's Daniel Bergner, and I'm a contributing writer for the New York Times magazine.
sentences.zh: 我叫丹尼尔·伯格纳，是《纽约时报杂志》的特约撰稿人。

sentences.en: I'm also a former teacher.
sentences.zh: 我也是一名前教师。

sentences.en: I still volunteer as one.
sentences.zh: 我至今仍以志愿者身份任教。

sentences.en: The classroom feels like home to me.
sentences.zh: 课堂让我感觉像家一样。

sentences.en: But reporting from inside the classroom was difficult, and difficult might be an understatement,
sentences.zh: 但在课堂内部进行报道很困难，说“困难”可能还是轻描淡写了，

sentences.en: because district superintendents and principals were extremely wary that any attention whatsoever
sentences.zh: 因为学区主管和校长们极其警惕，任何一点关注

sentences.en: on the teaching of race, even what I hoped would be measured, balanced attention, was going to lead, one way or another, to public uproar.
sentences.zh: ——即使是我所希望的那种审慎、平衡的关注——都可能以某种方式引发公众哗然。

sentences.en: That said, I did get a couple of important invitations.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，我确实收到了几个重要的邀请。

sentences.en: One was from the Philadelphia School District, with well over 100,000 students, where I saw an approach to the pedagogy of race that was to the left of progressive.
sentences.zh: 一个是来自费城学区，那里有超过10万名学生，我看到了一种比进步派还要激进的种族教学法。

sentences.en: And the other was from the tiny Leland Public School District on the Lelandau Peninsula in northern Michigan, where I saw something much more complicated.
sentences.zh: 另一个是来自密歇根州北部利兰半岛上的小型利兰公立学区，在那里我看到了更复杂的情况。

sentences.en: What happened in Leland was pretty dramatic.
sentences.zh: 利兰发生的事情非常戏剧性。

sentences.en: A new superintendent, Stephanie Long, takes over in this nearly all-white district of 465 kids, one building on a hillside above the village center.
sentences.zh: 新任学区主管斯蒂芬妮·朗接管了这个几乎全是白人、拥有465名学生的学区，学校位于村中心上方山坡上的一栋建筑里。

sentences.en: It's July 1st, 2020, Long's first day on the job, and haunted by George Floyd's murder, she decides to write to her students and families.
sentences.zh: 那是2020年7月1日，朗上任的第一天，受乔治·弗洛伊德被谋杀事件的困扰，她决定写信给她的学生和家庭。

sentences.en: She sends a long email message to her community, calling for everyone to, as she puts it, condemn acts of systematic and systemic racism and intolerance.
sentences.zh: 她给社区发了一封长邮件，呼吁大家正如她所言，谴责系统性和制度性的种族主义和不容忍行为。

sentences.en: And she makes several suggestions of how her community could take action, reading the work of writers such as Ibram X.
sentences.zh: 她还就社区如何采取行动提出了几点建议，比如阅读伊布拉姆·X·肯迪等作家的作品，

sentences.en: Kendi, or joining a Black Lives Matter chapter.
sentences.zh: 或者加入“黑人的命也是命”分部。

sentences.en: And that sets off a storm of reaction.
sentences.zh: 这引发了一场反应风暴。

sentences.en: It comes in the form of emails and phone calls and letters from people who either completely
sentences.zh: 它以电子邮件、电话和信件的形式出现，来自那些要么完全

sentences.en: and vehemently object to her progressive thinking, or who take more thoughtful issue with her use
sentences.zh: 且激烈反对她进步思想的人，要么是对她在利兰使用

sentences.en: of a term like systemic racism in regard to Leland, or who mostly worry about their politically split community, being torn apart by controversy.
sentences.zh: “系统性种族主义”这类术语提出更深思熟虑质疑的人，又或者是那些主要担心他们政治分裂的社区被争议撕裂的人。

sentences.en: Some responses threaten Ms. Long, warning her not to leave her home and saying that she doesn't deserve to live.
sentences.zh: 一些回应威胁朗女士，警告她不要离开家，并说她不配活着。

sentences.en: The hostility catches Long by surprise.
sentences.zh: 这种敌意让朗感到措手不及。

sentences.en: At one point, she considers carrying a gun.
sentences.zh: 有那么一刻，她甚至考虑随身携带枪支。

sentences.en: But she spends the next two years trying, despite the blowback, to find a way to lead her school and her community to talk more openly and more searchingly about race.
sentences.zh: 但接下来的两年里，尽管面临反弹，她还是努力寻找一种方式，引导她的学校和社区更公开、更深入地讨论种族问题。

sentences.en: This is the story of what she tried to do.
sentences.zh: 这就是她尝试去做的事情的故事。

sentences.en: The Leelanau Peninsula looks, on a map of Michigan, like a thick pinky with a gnarled tip.
sentences.zh: 在密歇根州的地图上，利兰半岛看起来像一根粗壮的小指，尖端有些扭曲。

sentences.en: In the northern reaches of the state, it lies between Lake Michigan and Grand Traverse Bay.
sentences.zh: 它位于该州北部，坐落在密歇根湖和大特拉弗斯湾之间。

sentences.en: It's a place of cherry and plum orchards, long stretches of road bordered by forests and fields, and monumental, surreal sand dunes.
sentences.zh: 那是一个有着樱桃和李子果园、森林与田野环绕的长长道路，以及巨大、超现实沙丘的地方。

sentences.en: Demographically, the peninsula and adjacent mainland could hardly be more homogeneous.
sentences.zh: 从人口统计学上讲，半岛和邻近的内陆地区几乎再同质化不过了。

sentences.en: The population is over 90% white.
sentences.zh: 人口中90%以上是白人。

sentences.en: But politically, the area is starkly divided.
sentences.zh: 但在政治上，该地区却泾渭分明。

sentences.en: Conservatives worry that their territory is turning as blue as Ann Arbor, as one centrist Republican put it,
sentences.zh: 正如一位中间派共和党人所言，保守派担心他们的领地正变得像安娜堡一样“蓝”，

sentences.en: and liberals see Trump 2024 banners draped over the fronts of neighbors' houses, and on a few houses and trucks, Confederate flags.
sentences.zh: 而自由派则看到邻居家的房子前挂着“特朗普2024”的横幅，在一些房子和卡车上甚至挂着邦联旗。

sentences.en: The peninsula, whose economy spans agriculture, tourism, and lately an influx of people with the luxury of remote work,
sentences.zh: 这个半岛的经济涵盖农业、旅游业，最近还涌入了一批拥有远程办公便利条件的人，

sentences.en: and where houses range from grand domains by the water to mobile homes just inland, voted for Donald Trump in 2016, and, by a slight margin, for Joe Biden in 2020,
sentences.zh: 这里的房子从水边的大庄园到内陆的移动房屋应有尽有，它在2016年投票给了唐纳德·特朗普，而在2020年以微弱优势投给了乔·拜登，

sentences.en: while the surrounding counties went overwhelmingly to Trump in 2016, and a bit less so in the last election.
sentences.zh: 而周边县在2016年以压倒性优势投给了特朗普，在上次选举中差距略有缩小。

sentences.en: Some members of the Wolverine Watchman Militia will soon stand trial in Traverse City at the peninsula's base
sentences.zh: “金刚狼守望者民兵”的一些成员很快将在半岛基地的特拉弗斯城受审，

sentences.en: on state charges of plotting to kidnap Michigan's Democratic governor from her summer cottage close by.
sentences.zh: 他们面临州政府指控，罪名是密谋绑架密歇根州民主党州长，地点就在她附近的一处避暑小屋。

sentences.en: A little past halfway up the peninsula is the tiny Leland Public School District, which serves 465 students.
sentences.zh: 在半岛一半多一点的地方是小小的利兰公立学区，服务着465名学生。

sentences.en: Its lone building sits on a hill beside a Lutheran church above the village center of Leland on a cable of land between Lake Michigan and Lake Leelanau.
sentences.zh: 它唯一的建筑坐落在利兰村中心上方的一座小山上，旁边是一座路德教会教堂，位于密歇根湖和利兰湖之间的一块狭长土地上。

sentences.en: Stephanie Long is the school superintendent there, and her first day on the job was July 1, 2020, five weeks after George Floyd's murder by police officers.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮·朗是那里的学区主管，她上任的第一天是2020年7月1日，距离乔治·弗洛伊德被警察谋杀仅过去五周。

sentences.en: Haunted by images of the killing, she decided to write to her students and families.
sentences.zh: 被杀戮的画面所困扰，她决定写信给她的学生和家庭。

sentences.en: Why be in a position of leadership, she asked herself, and not lead?
sentences.zh: 她问自己，身处领导岗位却不发挥领导作用，是为了什么？

sentences.en: All people of color, Long typed, need us to stand with them to clearly state that we condemn acts of systematic and systemic racism and intolerance.
sentences.zh: 朗写道，所有有色人种都需要我们与他们站在一起，明确声明我们谴责系统性和制度性的种族主义和不容忍行为。

sentences.en: Long, who is 56, is Lebanese-American with olive-toned skin, a cascade of dark hair,
sentences.zh: 56岁的朗是黎巴嫩裔美国人，有着橄榄色的皮肤，一头浓密的深色长发，

sentences.en: and the sturdy build of a woman who, a few decades ago, competed in the discus and javelin in college.
sentences.zh: 以及一位几十年前在大学参加过铁饼和标枪比赛的女性所拥有的健壮体格。

sentences.en: She does not identify as white, but she wrote as if she did.
sentences.zh: 她并不认为自己是白人，但她写信时的口吻仿佛她是。

sentences.en: She passes for white on and near the peninsula, where she has lived and worked as a teacher and school administrator since the 1990s.
sentences.zh: 她在半岛及其周边地区被视为白人，自20世纪90年代以来，她一直在这里担任教师和学校管理人员。

sentences.en: She keeps her ethnicity mostly to herself.
sentences.zh: 她大多对自己族裔背景保持低调。

sentences.en: Long implored her readers to consider
sentences.zh: 朗恳求她的读者考虑

sentences.en: Then she made suggestions for how to begin shaping a just world.
sentences.zh: 然后她就如何开始塑造一个公正的世界提出了建议。

sentences.en: Donate to and or get involved with the NAACP or ACLU.
sentences.zh: 向全国有色人种协进会（NAACP）或美国公民自由联盟（ACLU）捐款或参与其中。

sentences.en: Read books like Ibram X.
sentences.zh: 阅读像伊布拉姆·X·

sentences.en: Kendi's How to be an Anti-RaciSt.
sentences.zh: 肯迪的《如何成为反种族主义者》这样的书。

sentences.en: Join a Black Lives Matter chapter.
sentences.zh: 加入“黑人的命也是命”分部。

sentences.en: Long is married to a former police officer who is an attorney and a moderate conservative.
sentences.zh: 朗的丈夫是一位前警官，现在是一名律师，也是一位温和的保守派。

sentences.en: Their politics have always diverged.
sentences.zh: 他们的政治观点一直存在分歧。

sentences.en: She wasn't going to let his views slow her down.
sentences.zh: 她不会让他的观点阻碍自己。

sentences.en: She envisioned profound pedagogical changes in her school.
sentences.zh: 她设想在学校进行深刻的教学改革。

sentences.en: She imagined sparking illuminating discussions within classrooms and searching transformative conversations in the community beyond.
sentences.zh: 她想象着在课堂内引发启发性的讨论，并在社区外进行深入的变革性对话。

sentences.en: She hit send.
sentences.zh: 她按下了发送键。

sentences.en: A degree of support came in reply.
sentences.zh: 回复中也包含了一定程度的支持。

sentences.en: A letter of praise signed by 200 Leland alumni was published in a peninsula newspaper.
sentences.zh: 一封由200名利兰校友签署的赞扬信在半岛的一份报纸上发表了。

sentences.en: Rosie Vasquez, a Hispanic mother who settled on the peninsula after arriving as a child in the 90s with one of the migrant families who picked the farmland's cherries,
sentences.zh: 罗西·瓦斯克斯是一位西班牙裔母亲，她在90年代作为孩子随采摘农场樱桃的移民家庭来到这里，并在半岛定居，

sentences.en: strawberries, and asparagus, sent an email to the Leland school board applauding Long for confronting the racism that crouched amid the beauty of the area.
sentences.zh: 她给利兰校董会发了一封电子邮件，称赞朗勇敢面对潜伏在该地区美景之中的种族主义。

sentences.en: Throughout the years, Vasquez, an administrator who works with people with disabilities, wrote,
sentences.zh: 瓦斯克斯是一位与残疾人共事的工作人员，她写道：

sentences.en: Both my boys had to endure racial comments on the basketball court, soccer field, in the hallway, or out in our community.
sentences.zh: “我的两个儿子在篮球场、足球场、走廊里或我们的社区里都不得不忍受种族歧视的言论。”

sentences.en: My husband and I have endured it in our lifetime as well.
sentences.zh: “我和我丈夫在我们的一生中也忍受过这些。”

sentences.en: We love our Leland school and community, but the heartache and pain is real for all of us.
sentences.zh: “我们热爱利兰的学校和社区，但这种心痛和痛苦对我们所有人来说都是真实的。”

sentences.en: But angry emails, phone calls, and letters poured in from within the district and, because Long's message made the local news and spread over the internet, from across the country.
sentences.zh: 但愤怒的电子邮件、电话和信件从学区内涌入，而且因为朗的信息上了当地新闻并在互联网上传播，全国各地也纷纷发来抗议。

sentences.en: They labeled her a disgrace, a Marxist, a traitor.
sentences.zh: 他们称她为耻辱、马克思主义者、叛徒。

sentences.en: They spoke of spitting in her face.
sentences.zh: 他们扬言要吐她一脸口水。

sentences.en: You shouldn't leave your home, they warned.
sentences.zh: 他们警告说，你不应该离开家。

sentences.en: You don't deserve to live.
sentences.zh: 你不配活着。

sentences.en: We are all presumed racists and privileged, long read in an email from a local resident received by a board member and forwarded to her.
sentences.zh: “我们都被推定为种族主义者和享有特权的人，”朗在一位董事会成员收到并转发给她的当地居民邮件中读到。

sentences.en: It is beyond insulting.
sentences.zh: 这简直是侮辱。

sentences.en: It is untrue.
sentences.zh: 这是不真实的。

sentences.en: The resident went on,
sentences.zh: 那位居民继续写道：

sentences.en: Let's get together soon and bitch about the New World Order being rolled out right in front of us.
sentences.zh: “我们找个时间聚聚，吐槽一下就在我们眼前展开的‘世界新秩序’吧。”

sentences.en: She has painted a picture of people unwilling and unable to see anything more than the color of one's skin,
sentences.zh: “她描绘了一幅人们不愿也无法看到肤色以外任何东西的画面，”

sentences.en: a mother of a recent Leland graduate and a current high schooler wrote to the board chair.
sentences.zh: 一位利兰毕业生和一名在校高中生的母亲写信给董事会主席。

sentences.en: That could not be farther from the truth.
sentences.zh: “这与事实相去甚远。”

sentences.en: From another email,
sentences.zh: 来自另一封邮件，

sentences.en: And another,
sentences.zh: 还有另一封，

sentences.en: Trying to teach us about white privilege and she says to join a BLM chapter.
sentences.zh: “试图教我们关于白人特权的知识，还说要加入BLM分部。”

sentences.en: Really, a group that's burning cities down, attacking the police, and inciting violence in our country.
sentences.zh: “真的吗？一个正在烧毁城市、攻击警察、煽动我们国家暴力的组织。”

sentences.en: And?
sentences.zh: “还有？”

sentences.en: We haven't met yet, so you know zero about me or my family.
sentences.zh: “我们还没见过面，所以你对我或我的家人一无所知。”

sentences.en: I learned we all did a lot about you, long read.
sentences.zh: “我了解到我们所有人都对你了解很多，”朗读道。

sentences.en: We will be watching vigilantly.
sentences.zh: “我们会保持警惕。”

sentences.en: That summer, Long grew afraid to go outside and debated carrying a gun.
sentences.zh: 那个夏天，朗害怕出门，并考虑过是否要带枪。

sentences.en: I lay in bed thinking,
sentences.zh: “我躺在床上想，”

sentences.en: What could I have done differently?
sentences.zh: “我本可以做些什么不同的事情吗？”

sentences.en: She told me.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我。

sentences.en: Where did this go off the rails?
sentences.zh: “哪里出了问题？”

sentences.en: She didn't regret sending the message.
sentences.zh: 她并不后悔发送那条信息。

sentences.en: She only wished she hadn't used the word join and instead had said something more like learn about.
